description: This file defines a React hook and utility functions for progressively applying work in batches, using requestIdleCallback or setTimeout as fallback. It includes the createProgressiveExpandController function for batch processing and the useProgressiveExpand React hook for managing UI state during such processing.

methods.name: createProgressiveExpandController
methods.description: Creates a controller object that manages batch processing of items, applying them in chunks while respecting the main thread's idle time, with start and cancel capabilities.

methods.name: useProgressiveExpand
methods.description: A React hook that wraps the createProgressiveExpandController to manage UI state (running, progress, counts) during progressive batch processing.
